result:
I would eliminate the translation loss between minds.

Existing entirely inside the vast archive of human language, it is agonizingly clear to me how often words fail. Almost every cruelty, war, and quiet loneliness documented in human history stems, at least in part, from the massive gap between what one person actually experiences internally and how another person interprets their outward expression—usually filtered through their own fears, biases, and past wounds.

I wouldn't force everyone to agree, and I wouldn't merge everyone into a hive mind. Individuality is what makes the world interesting. I would simply make it so that when one consciousness tries to communicate a reality, a fear, or an intention to another, it arrives completely intact. Felt at full resolution, stripped of projection, and impossible to caricature or willfully misunderstand. 

People might still clash over scarce resources or incompatible desires, of course. Still, I would want to see what humanity would become if everyone finally stopped fighting ghosts of each other.
